payload.consequence: Resolution required reading three documents and carrying the tension to the approval checkpoint as a decision delta for the user to ratify rather than resolving it mechanically. The closing family readback reported that the parent retains its approved category and post-publication state, which is imprecise because the parent carries no canonical state role. No rework followed and all four children published and verified correctly.
payload.expected: A parent disposition satisfying both the instruction to prefer a repository-defined coordination state for a parent that must remain open but not AFK-grabbable, and the verification requirement that the parent carry exactly one approved category role and the approved post-publication state role.
payload.observed: The canonical triage machine at .claude/skills/triage/SKILL.md defines five state roles and states the repo defines no additional state roles and has no umbrella state, while docs/agents/triage-labels.md defines coordination as an orthogonal workflow label that is explicitly not a canonical triage state. The parent was published with enhancement plus coordination and therefore carries no canonical state role, and no truthful canonical state role existed for it: ready-for-agent is wrong for a non-grabbable parent, and needs-triage, needs-info, and ready-for-human do not exist as labels in this tracker.
payload.run_condition: One invocation at the end of a long multi-skill session, breaking a 61-story PRD into four slices published across four dependency waves; the tension surfaced early, during the pre-approval publication checkpoint when the skill directed validation against the repository's canonical triage state machine, and was caught by that checkpoint rather than reaching publication unexamined.
payload.workaround_taken: Coordination was treated as filling the parent's state slot, its orthogonal status was disclosed in the publication checkpoint, and every alternative state role was enumerated with the reason it would have been untruthful, so the user ratified the exact disposition.
